description_en: Queries the SNAT entries that have been created
description_zh: 调用DescribeSnatTableEntries接口查询已创建的SNAT条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-snat-table-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --snat-table-id stb-8vbczigrhop8x5u3t0000 --snat-entry-id snat-8vbae8uqh7rjpk7d20000 --source-vswitch-id vsw-3xbjkhjshjdf0000 --source-cidr 116.22.XX.XX/24 --snat-ip 116.22.XX.XX --snat-entry-name SnatEntry-1 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --nat-gateway-id ngw-bp1uewa15k4iy57700000 --network-interface-ids eni-gw8g131ef2dnbu3k0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSnatTableEntries

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
NAT网关所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the SNAT table. 

You must specify at least one of SnatTableId and NatGatewayId
parameters.help_zh:
SNAT表ID。 

SnatTableId和NatGatewayId参数至少输入一个
parameters.name: snat_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SNAT entry
parameters.name: snat_entry_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch.

When you query SNAT entries of an Internet NAT gateway, this parameter specifies the vSwitch whose ECS instances can access the Internet by using the SNAT rule.

When you query SNAT entries of a VPC NAT gateway, this parameter specifies the vSwitch whose ECS instances can access external networks by using the SNAT rule
parameters.help_zh:
交换机的ID。

当查询公网NAT网关的SNAT条目时，该参数表示该交换机内的ECS实例均可以通过SNAT规则访问公网。

当查询VPC NAT网关的SNAT条目时，该参数表示该交换机内的ECS实例均可以通过SNAT规则访问外部网络
parameters.name: source_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The source CIDR block of the SNAT entry
parameters.name: source_cidr

parameters.help_en:
When you query SNAT entries of an Internet NAT gateway, this parameter specifies the elastic IP address (EIP) in the SNAT entry.
 
When you query SNAT entries of a VPC NAT gateway, this parameter specifies the NAT IP address in the SNAT entry
parameters.help_zh:
当查询公网NAT网关的SNAT条目时，该参数为SNAT条目中的EIP。
 
当查询VPC NAT网关的SNAT条目时，该参数为SNAT条目中的NAT IP地址
parameters.name: snat_ip

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SNAT entry.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
SNAT条目的名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头， 可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: snat_entry_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the NAT gateway to query.

You must specify at least one of SnatTableId and NatGatewayId
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的NAT网关的ID。

SnatTableId和NatGatewayId参数至少输入一个
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) to query
parameters.name: network_interface_ids

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
